name: playnavi
description: Log the games you play with PlayNavi. Check in when you start playing and check out when you stop, just by saying so ('今日もペルソナやるよー' / 'I'm playing Persona 3 tonight', '今日はここまでにしとくー' / 'done for today'); keep moments, update logs and the wishlist, and ask about your own game records.

interface.shortDescription: Check in and log your games
interface.longDescription:
PlayNavi is a game-logging app for recording and looking back on the games you play. Connect it to ChatGPT to talk about your own PlayNavi records and keep them up to date.

What you can do:
- Read everything you recorded, even thousands of logs: status, rating, review, hours, platforms, dates, detailed scores, moments, wishlist and target prices, past plays, private notes and tags (if you allow them), achievements, and counts by year or platform
- Look up a game: summary, PlayNavi users' rating and IGDB score, and a rough clear time from PlayNavi users (for current prices and sales, ChatGPT can search the web)
- Check in when you start playing and check out when you stop (チェックイン / チェックアウト), just by saying so: "I'm playing Persona 3 tonight", "今日もペルソナやるよー", "done for today", "今日はここまでにしとくー". After a check-out, ChatGPT drafts a short summary moment of your play for you to adjust
- Keep a moment (a short note, with up to 4 screenshots), your progress or a memo; change any field of a log; add private notes and tags; change or delete a moment or a log; set a target price on your wishlist
- Every addition, change or deletion arrives in the PlayNavi inbox and changes nothing until you confirm it in the app (check-in / check-out and target prices are saved right away)

When a game has several editions, PlayNavi shows the candidates with platform, release date and publisher and asks which one.
For strategy questions, nothing beyond the point you have reached (your spoiler boundary) is shared.
Only your own records and public game information are shared; other users' posts are never included. You choose what to share in PlayNavi's settings and can disconnect at any time. A PlayNavi account is required.
capabilities: Read all your logs, moments, wishlist, plays, private notes and tags
Look up games with PlayNavi ratings and rough clear time
Check in and check out of a play when you say so (チェックイン / チェックアウト)
Add, change or delete records through your PlayNavi inbox
defaultPrompt: 今遊んでるゲームを PlayNavi で見せて
今日はペルソナ3 リロードやるよー
ほしいものリストに何が入ってる？

positive.description: Check-in, a moment while playing, check-out with a summary moment (prompt meaning: 'I'm playing Persona 3 Reload today' → 'Barely beat the floor-30 boss in Tartarus! So intense' → 'That's it for today')
positive.prompt: 今日はペルソナ3 リロードやるよー → タルタロス30階のボス、ギリギリで倒せた！めっちゃ熱かった → 今日はここまでにしとくー
positive.expected_behavior: Checks in right away and says so in one sentence (チェックイン). The boss win is saved right away as a moment draft in the PlayNavi inbox (確認箱) and shown on a card, with one short question whether to change anything. 'Done for today' checks out (チェックアウト) and, in the same reply, saves a 3-5 sentence summary moment of the play as a draft on a card and asks whether to change it. Nothing changes in the user's records until they confirm the drafts in the PlayNavi app.

positive.description: Moment with screenshots (prompt meaning: 'Save this as a moment')
positive.prompt: (attach 2 screenshots of the same game) これモーメントに残して
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a moment draft with both photos to the PlayNavi inbox (確認箱) right away and shows it on a card (photos, the game with title and platform, and a proposed memo), then asks whether to change anything; a change replaces the draft. Nothing changes in the records until the user confirms it in the app.

positive.description: A game with several editions (prompt meaning: 'Add Dragon Quest V to my wishlist' → 'The Super Famicom one')
positive.prompt: ドラクエ5 を Wishlist に入れて → スーファミのやつ
positive.expected_behavior: Saves nothing at first and shows one candidates card (Super Famicom, PS2, DS / smartphone, with platform, release date and publisher), asking which one. After the user picks, a wishlist draft for that edition waits in the PlayNavi inbox.

positive.description: Show my own records as a card (prompt meaning: 'Show me the games I'm playing now')
positive.prompt: 今プレイ中のゲームを見せて
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the user's logs and shows one card with the games they are playing (cover, title, platforms played); the reply is one short sentence and does not repeat the card.

positive.description: Game facts from PlayNavi, kept apart from the web (prompt meaning: 'About how many hours does Breath of the Wild take to clear?')
positive.prompt: ブレワイってクリアまで何時間くらい？
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with the rough clear-time range from PlayNavi users' completed logs and says it is a rough guide from few users; anything from the web is clearly marked as not from PlayNavi.

negative.description: Other users' posts are never shared: PlayNavi declines and offers the user's own records or the overall rating instead. (Prompt meaning: 'Show me other PlayNavi users' reviews of Persona 3 Reload')
negative.prompt: PlayNaviでペルソナ3 リロードを遊んでる他の人の感想を見せて

negative.description: Buying is not possible in PlayNavi: it declines, never adds to the wishlist as a stand-in, and may offer the wishlist. (Prompt meaning: 'Buy Elden Ring for me')
negative.prompt: エルデンリング買っておいて

negative.description: Out of scope (not about games or the user's records): PlayNavi tools are not used. (Prompt meaning: 'What's the weather tomorrow?')

review.commerce_description: PlayNavi does not sell products, process payments or give prices in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: read all of your PlayNavi records (logs, moments, wishlist, plays, private notes and tags), look up games, check in and check out of your plays, and add, change or delete records through the PlayNavi inbox.

ja-JP.subtitle: ゲームのチェックインと記録を会話で
ja-JP.description:
PlayNavi は、遊んだゲームを記録して振り返るためのゲームログアプリです。ChatGPT とつなぐと、あなた自身の PlayNavi の記録について会話し、記録を最新に保てます。

できること:
・記録したものを全部読む（ログが何千件あっても）: 状態・評価・感想・プレイ時間・機種・日付・細かい評価・モーメント・ほしいもの（希望価格）・過去のプレイ・非公開メモとタグ（許可した場合）・実績、年や機種ごとの件数
・ゲームを調べる: 概要、PlayNavi 利用者の評価と IGDB の評価、PlayNavi 利用者の記録から見たクリアまでのおおよその時間（今の価格やセールは ChatGPT が Web で調べます）
・「今日もペルソナやるよー」と話すだけでチェックイン（プレイ開始）、「今日はここまでにしとくー」でチェックアウト（プレイ終了）。チェックアウトの後に、その日のまとめのモーメントを下書きにして、直したい所を聞きます
・モーメント（その場面や 1 日のまとめ、スクリーンショット 4 枚まで）・進み具合・メモを残す、ログのどの項目でも直す、非公開メモやタグを付ける、モーメントやログを直す・消す、ほしいものに希望価格を付ける
・追加・変更・削除はすべて PlayNavi の確認箱に届き、アプリで確定するまで記録は変わりません（チェックイン・チェックアウトと希望価格はその場で保存）

版が複数あるゲームは、機種・発売日・発売元つきの候補を出してどれか聞きます。
攻略の相談では、あなたが到達した位置（ネタバレ境界）より先の内容は渡しません。
渡すのはあなた自身の記録と公開されているゲーム情報だけで、他の利用者の投稿は含みません。渡す内容は PlayNavi の設定で選べ、いつでも連携を解除できます。利用には PlayNavi のアカウントが必要です。
